verdict_reason: The new searchRole tests pin search-by-use alone, with several roles, OR-ed with q and countryCode, narrowed by role, a blank value dropped and an unknown value refused, each failing without the change; only a Minor title-convention breach.

todos.issue: The seven added searchRole tests (:252-:329) are titled list_with...<outcome> with no 'should', while the rest of the file uses plain sentences (partialWordSearchMatchesNameCaseInsensitively, :20) and the sibling AddressListIT in this PR uses list_should..._when.... integration.md sets {subject}_{shouldDoWhat}_{whenContext}; one file now carries two title conventions.
todos.fix: Must: the added tests follow {subject}_{shouldDoWhat}_{whenContext}, matching AddressListIT. One way: list_shouldReturnTheAddressesHoldingTheSearchRole_whenOnlyASearchRoleIsGiven, list_shouldReturn400BadRequestProblemWithNoErrorsMap_whenASearchRoleIsUnknown.
